messages:
Maya G.: quick heads-up — saw repeated tail-latency spikes last night when a node entered thermal throttle (GPU clocks bumped down). thinking we need a graceful-degrade policy for dedicated pools rather than hard eviction + scale.
Alex R.: which pool/cluster? any logs or graphs? :thinking:
Maya G.: dedicated-gpu-prod-us-west-2, around 02:12 UTC. tiny log excerpt: `thermal_event: true, clocks: 1100->600, active_tenants: 28, p95: 620ms -> 1.8s`
Samir: ugh. hard evicting tenants when clocks drop is noisy. propose "burst-lane + soft-eviction credits" — let low-priority tenants bleed tokens instead of immediate preempt.
Jin: can you sketch the control knobs? i worry about cache churn and cold KV warmups if we push everyone off.
Maya G.: rough idea: when node reports thermal_throttle -> mark pool in `soft_degrade` mode. policy gates: 1) open a burst lane (small token-bucket) for short bursts, 2) apply progressive qps cap for low-priority tenants, 3) soft-eviction credits that decay over 10m so we don't aggressively evict steady low-load tenants.
Alex R.: sample config snippet?
Maya G.: pasted config stub: ```yaml
policy:
  mode: soft_degrade_on_thermal
  burst_lane:
    enabled: true
    token_bucket:
      capacity: 120
      refill_per_sec: 2
  qps_caps:
    priority_high: null
    priority_low: 5
  eviction:
    threshold_util_pct: 0.90
    soft_credit_duration: 10m
    hard_evict_after_credits: 3
```
Samir: i'd change `hard_evict_after_credits` to be tenant-based and tied to a cost budget rather than a simple count. also add a minimum prewarm retention for canary models.
Jin: routing impact? requests should prefer healthy nodes; for soft_degrade we still accept requests but with slower token issuance. we need `soft_degrade_request_shed_rate` metric for alerts.
Maya G.: agreed. instrument: per-tenant p50/p95, token-bucket drain rate, kvcache-hit after degrade, eviction-credit-usage. will add to pool dashboard.
Alex R.: ops/rollback playbook? if soft_degrade increases p95 for important tenants we need instant rollback to normal routing + fallback to other region/model variant.
Maya G.: rollout: `dedicated-thermal-staging` pool in staging -> canary 10% tenants in prod with flag `thermal_soft_degrade_v1`. alert if prod canary p95 increases >10% for high-priority tenants.
Samir: instrumentation checklist: gpu_temp_histogram, throttle_events, p95_by_priority, tokens_burned_by_tenant. i'll add those metrics.
Jin: adding operator kill-switch and per-tenant opt-out for soft eviction.
Alex R.: should we correlate with node thermal forecasts? pre-warm fallback nodes earlier to reduce evictions. predictive lead time could be a hook.
Maya G.: for v1 we'll do reactive soft_degrade + observability. v2: integrate thermal forecast to pre-provision warm nodes.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: feature-flag `thermal_soft_degrade_v1` enabled in staging at 2026-03-22T10:15:00Z :white_check_mark:
Samir: i'll start a short-lived dashboard and a Prometheus job to collect the new metrics.
Jin: i'll add the operator flag and the per-tenant override API.
Alex R.: please open a follow-up RFC draft with these knobs and the rollout plan. include the YAML stub and the alert thresholds. i'll review.
Maya G.: will do. thanks — this should reduce noise from thermal events without dramatic tenant churn. :thumbsup:
